articles.title: The Ethereum Foundation is facing a wave of high-profile departures as its internal shakeup deepens
articles.snippet: The turnover comes as the foundation undergoes an internal transition tied to a new organizational mandate aimed at redefining its role within Ethereum.

articles.title: Mike Novogratz’s Galaxy receives New York BitLicense for institutional crypto push
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital became the second company this year to secure a New York BitLicense, following Strike’s approval in March.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) drops 13% as all assets decline
articles.snippet: Bittensor (TAO), down 9.6% over the weekend, joined Bitcoin Cash (BCH) as an underperformer.

articles.title: Crypto funds see $1B in outflows as Iran tensions revive risk-off sentiment
articles.snippet: Institutional investors pulled capital from Bitcoin and Ether products as Iran tension and rising inflation rattled markets, while XRP and Solana funds continued to attract fresh inflows.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to $76K after Trump says ‘clock is ticking’ for Iran
articles.snippet: Bitcoin analysis says BTC price could revisit the $65,000 demand area after fresh US-Iran war tensions soured the crypto market mood.
